basic_info.chief_complaint: I requested to have my upper left wisdom teeth removed, so I came to our hospital for treatment today.

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: I requested to have my upper left wisdom teeth removed, so I came to our hospital for treatment today.

oral_examination.oral_examination: *28 Black caries were seen on the maxillary surface, and the texture was hard when probed. Deep caries holes were detected on the distal and proximal surfaces. When probed and percussed, the teeth were not loose, and the gums were not red or swollen.

treatment_plan.notes: Routine medical advice and follow-up consultation if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: *28 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine was used to divide the gingiva, increase the gap, and loosen the gums. They were pulled out by pulling and compressing to stop bleeding.
